neet_che_u11_t06_1.working: The highest actinoid oxidation state is +7. Np and Pu show it, for example in NpO5^3- and PuO5^3-.

neet_che_u11_t06_2.working: Th has the configuration [Rn]6d2 7s2, so it has no 5f electron. Am is 5f7 7s2, U is 5f3 6d1 7s2 and Cm is 5f7 6d1 7s2.

neet_che_u11_t06_3.working: The 5f, 6d and 7s levels have comparable energies, so a variable number of electrons can be lost.

neet_che_u11_t06_4.working: Per NCERT, the actinoid contraction from element to element is greater than the lanthanoid contraction, so A is false. The cause is the poorer shielding by 5f electrons, so R is true.

neet_che_u11_t06_5.working: U +6 is common, as in UO2^2+ and UF6, so I is correct. The later actinoids show mainly +3, so II is incorrect.
